description: This file defines an abstract class 'DownloadFormat' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Maintenance DownloadFormats plugin. The class provides a common interface for formatting download files related to employee data, including methods to get formatted string, generate download filenames, and access the EmployeeService to retrieve employee information.

classes.name: DownloadFormat
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a blueprint for specific download format implementations related to employee data export.

methods.name: getFormattedString
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, returning a formatted string based on input values.

methods.name: getDownloadFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the employee data download, appending '(Past Employee)' if applicable.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Provides an instance of EmployeeService, initializing it if not already set.
